reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We close this gap with a medical perturbation audit: a 30-operator battery edits both the chain and the question with clinically motivated operators (severity reversal, negation flip, demographic swap, evidence ablation), paired with a chain-update times answer-flip joint analysis that classifies each model by its failure mode.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Applied to 14 LLMs on four medical QA benchmarks, three independent tests converge: the Chain-Decoupling Rate (CDR; chain does not register the edit and the answer does not flip) is 72.9% panel-wide on clinically meaningful destructive edits, chain corruption leaves accuracy unchanged, and removing CoT prompting does not reduce accuracy.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Two board-certified clinicians re-annotate N=197 perturbed questions; 98.5% leave the gold defensible.
